# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts to extreme tightness, a breakout with expanded volume signals the start of a new trending leg. This captures momentum after volatility compression, where the tight EMA ribbon indicates equilibrium and the volume-expanded breakout indicates institutional participation driving a directional move.

## Mechanism

Compute ribbon width = |EMA8 - EMA55| on 5-minute bars. If width is at or below its 10th percentile over the last 20 periods AND price closes above the highest high of the prior 20-period range on the same bar AND volume > 2 * average 5-minute volume over the last 20 periods, then enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: initial stop at the low of the breakout bar; primary target at 2R (risk = entry - stop); if price reaches 1.5R, activate a premium-stop trail at 1.2% of entry price. Avoid trading in the first 15 minutes after open (09:30-09:45 ET) to reduce opening-range noise. Ideal regime: VIX < 18.
